name: fluid-skill
description: Apple-platform UI design, coding style, long-term maintainability and animated sequence visualizations: Swift, UIKit, AppKit and web UI preferences

interface.shortDescription: Apple UI design, coding style, maintainability and sequence animations
interface.longDescription: Applies language-neutral principles (coding-aesthetics), their Swift and Apple-platform form (ios-coding-aesthetics), and web UI specifics (web-coding-aesthetics). Designs native SwiftUI, UIKit and AppKit interfaces through constraints, layout exploration, prototypes and evidence (ui-design). Adds judgment about present complexity and future change costs (long-term-maintainability). Animates how events and state move between components, step by step, with video export (sequence-visualization).
defaultPrompt: Use $ios-coding-aesthetics to design this Swift package.
Review this change's maintenance costs with $long-term-maintainability.
Animate this ordering bug step by step with $sequence-visualization.
